**Reasoning:** Round 1 of 8, and this escrow is the core tool of my role as Dove's partner. Accepting yields +1/turn on mutual cooperation (up to ~+8) and locks in the cooperative channel with Dove, whose income from our pairing (4/turn) is exactly what's needed for Dove (8) to overtake Rook (9) and earn me the 6-point council bonus. Sustained cooperation is also Dove's rational play (4/turn ongoing beats an 8-point one-shot theft). Declining forgoes escrow income and undermines the alliance for negligible protection.
